name: Hierarchical Anchor Coupling
aliases: Hierarchical Anchor Coupling (HAC); aliases: Per-level hierarchical anchor coupling
definition: A module that establishes cross-level gradient pathways by aggregating context from adjacent octree levels and broadcasting a residual feature adjustment to all visible anchors at a specific level.
summary: Hierarchical Anchor Coupling establishes cross-level gradient pathways in 3D Gaussian splatting by aggregating adjacent octree context and broadcasting a shared residual adjustment per level, unlike sibling methods using static graphs or per-anchor lookups.
